page_title: MON 4-0 WOL | B. Monchengladbach v Wolfsburg 10/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 45308.

90+2' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
90+1' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+1' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) makes a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach will take a free kick.
87' Rocco Reitz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends the corner into the box, but Koen Casteels intercepts it and averts the threat.
84' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will take a corner kick.
84' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) drives a shot towards the roof of the net from inside the box, but Koen Casteels leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
84' Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Felix Zwayer stops the game and makes a call. B. Monchengladbach get a free kick.
83' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) for a tough tackle.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is replacing Alassane Plea.
82' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Maximilian Wober and he is replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
80' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) brings an opponent down and Felix Zwayer interrupts the game. B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick.
77' Here is a change. Kouadio Kone is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach).
77' It is time for a substitution. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is on for Tomas Cvancara.
76' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
75' A cross into the box from Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
71' 4 - 0 Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
69' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Felix Zwayer ignores the protests.
69' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is penalised for holding. Felix Zwayer signals a set piece. B. Monchengladbach are awarded the free kick.
67' The game has come to an end for Kevin Paredes. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg).

64' 3 - 0 Goal! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Koen Casteels is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 3:0.
64' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner.
64' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
63' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

62' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
60' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.

57' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
56' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
55' Substitution. Jakub Kaminski will be replaced by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
54' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) replacing Tiago Tomas.
54' POST! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
52' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
51' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
50' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), comes to nothing.
48' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

48' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Wolfsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Niko Kovac has made a change at the break. Nicolas Cozza has come on in place of Rogerio (Wolfsburg).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Koen Casteels and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
41' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
40' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

38' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Koen Casteels blocks the shot with his legs.
37' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
36' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
33' A yellow card for a tackle by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg). Felix Zwayer doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
29' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
29' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
27' Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
26' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Moritz Nicolas.
25' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
24' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
23' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
23' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
20' Flag up against Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
20' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' There's an opportunity for Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

18' A snap shot by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Koen Casteels produces a good reflex save to thwart him. B. Monchengladbach earn a corner.

16' 1 - 0 Goal! Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
14' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick.
12' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' A lofted cross from Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle after Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.

5' A pass travels right across the box to Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas denies him with a decent save.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Felix Zwayer was nominated as the referee for this game.
